stage: Post-training descriptive mechanism analysis, specified before all 36 runs completed
selection: All four methods, three objectives, three seeds and both recorded splits; include every initial checkpoint. No model or hyperparameter selection.
inputs: Frozen expert outputs, original mixture weights, saved candidate weights and exact measured KL/CE
questions: Does function matching improve output fidelity while coefficient error or mask disagreement remains?
How much original routing mass is omitted by the candidate top4?
Does coefficient error move toward directions with lower expert-output sensitivity?
metrics: coefficient squared L2 and L1; original top1 retained; original routing mass omitted
centered expert-output squared error, computed directly and by full Gram
individual centered expert energies and signed cross term; aggregate cancellation fraction
output-error/coefficient-error Rayleigh quotient, with explicit zero-error handling
descriptive Spearman correlations with measured exact KL
interpretation: Output and cross-term decompositions use the explicit centered-expert gauge. Correlations describe observed adapted checkpoints; they are not interventions on expert family structure.
resources: CPU-only, one thread; no training, no new label access, no GPU; never overwrite existing output
